_readme: The day's program. status: 'pending' while the program is not published (pages show only the start and end times from site.json and a note that the program will be available on this website shortly) or 'published' (pages list the sessions below; this takes effect only when sessions is not empty). Each session: start and end as "HH:MM" in Eastern Time (the event timezone, site.json → event.timezone, America/New_York; the day runs 11:00 to 19:00), title and titleEs, summary and summaryEs (plain text; may be ""), legacy: recovery | unity | service | all, kind: opening | talk | session | break | closing. Keep sessions in time order, and enter only what the committee has announced.
